content: {"rule": "K-S2", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "the passive egennēthē (was born) with feminine hēs (of whom) admits both the withheld-father and the birth-narration readings", "why": "The judge treats Matthew 1:16's admission of two readings—i.e., a single verse not stating the link or its contrary—as a ground for UNDERDETERMINED, which K-S2 forbids."}
